response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project work via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js — raising concerns about his ability to deliver on the core C++-centric routing tiling responsibilities.
strengths: Built open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages
Strong background in testing, CI/CD, and system reliability practices
concerns: No demonstrated commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or map tiling
Recent roles focus on web/TypeScript, not low-latency systems or geospatial data pipelines
Missing evidence of distributed systems or fault-tolerant routing data infrastructure work
